 ## Synopsis
 
 Run the GitLab Orbit CLI through glab.
 
+Coding agents: run `glab orbit --yes skills get orbit` to load the Orbit skill. `--yes` installs the binary without a prompt on first use.
+
 Every command and flag, including `--help`, is forwarded verbatim to the managed Orbit binary. glab downloads, verifies, and updates that binary for you on first use. Until the binary is installed, `--help` shows this text instead. glab passes your resolved GitLab credential to the binary on every invocation, so remote commands such as `glab orbit query` need no separate login.
 
 glab handles only the `update` command and the `--install`, `--update`, and `--yes` flags itself. Run `glab help orbit` to see them.

+func TestNewClientFromConfig_KeyringTokenMissing(t *testing.T) {
+	keyring.MockInit()
+	t.Cleanup(keyring.MockInit)
+
+	t.Setenv("GITLAB_TOKEN", "")
+	t.Setenv("GITLAB_ACCESS_TOKEN", "")
+	t.Setenv("OAUTH_TOKEN", "")
+	t.Setenv("GLAB_IS_OAUTH2", "")
+	t.Setenv("JOB_TOKEN", "")
+	t.Setenv("CI_JOB_TOKEN", "")
+	t.Setenv("GITLAB_CI", "")
+	t.Setenv("GLAB_ENABLE_CI_AUTOLOGIN", "")
+	t.Setenv("GLAB_USE_KEYRING", "")
+	t.Setenv("USE_KEYRING", "")
+
+	keyringHost := "---\nhosts:\n  gitlab.example.com:\n    use_keyring: \"true\"\n"
+
+	t.Run("returns an actionable error", func(t *testing.T) {
+		_, err := NewClientFromConfig("gitlab.example.com", config.NewFromString(keyringHost), false, "test-agent")
+		require.Error(t, err)
+		assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "keyring")
+		assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "re-authenticate")
+		assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "glab auth login --hostname gitlab.example.com")
+	})
+
+	t.Run("a token from the environment still wins", func(t *testing.T) {
+		t.Setenv("GITLAB_TOKEN", "env-pat")
+
+		client, err := NewClientFromConfig("gitlab.example.com", config.NewFromString(keyringHost), false, "test-agent")
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+
+		key, value, err := client.AuthSource().Header(t.Context())
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		assert.Equal(t, gitlab.AccessTokenHeaderName, key)
+		assert.Equal(t, "env-pat", value)
+	})
+
+	t.Run("a job token still authenticates", func(t *testing.T) {
+		t.Setenv("GLAB_ENABLE_CI_AUTOLOGIN", "true")
+		t.Setenv("GITLAB_CI", "true")
+		t.Setenv("CI_JOB_TOKEN", "env-job-token")
+
+		client, err := NewClientFromConfig("gitlab.example.com", config.NewFromString(keyringHost), false, "test-agent")
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+
+		key, value, err := client.AuthSource().Header(t.Context())
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		assert.Equal(t, gitlab.JobTokenHeaderName, key)
+		assert.Equal(t, "env-job-token", value)
+	})
+
+	t.Run("a host without use_keyring stays unauthenticated", func(t *testing.T) {
+		cfg := config.NewFromString("---\nhosts:\n  gitlab.example.com:\n    user: someone\n")
+
+		client, err := NewClientFromConfig("gitlab.example.com", cfg, false, "test-agent")
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+
+		_, _, err = client.AuthSource().Header(t.Context())
+		require.ErrorContains(t, err, "unauthenticated")
+	})
+
+	// The keyring is only read when the host itself sets use_keyring, so
+	// GLAB_USE_KEYRING alone must not turn a tokenless host into an error.
+	t.Run("GLAB_USE_KEYRING does not apply to a host without use_keyring", func(t *testing.T) {
+		t.Setenv("GLAB_USE_KEYRING", "true")
+		cfg := config.NewFromString("---\nhosts:\n  gitlab.example.com:\n    user: someone\n")
+
+		client, err := NewClientFromConfig("gitlab.example.com", cfg, false, "test-agent")
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+
+		_, _, err = client.AuthSource().Header(t.Context())
+		require.ErrorContains(t, err, "unauthenticated")
+	})
+
+	t.Run("a top-level use_keyring does not apply to a host without use_keyring", func(t *testing.T) {
+		cfg := config.NewFromString("---\nuse_keyring: \"true\"\nhosts:\n  gitlab.example.com:\n    user: someone\n")
+
+		client, err := NewClientFromConfig("gitlab.example.com", cfg, false, "test-agent")
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+
+		_, _, err = client.AuthSource().Header(t.Context())
+		require.ErrorContains(t, err, "unauthenticated")
+	})
+
+	t.Run("a top-level use_keyring keeps the token from the host entry", func(t *testing.T) {
+		cfg := config.NewFromString("---\nuse_keyring: \"true\"\nhosts:\n  gitlab.example.com:\n    token: config-pat\n")
+
+		client, err := NewClientFromConfig("gitlab.example.com", cfg, false, "test-agent")
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+
+		key, value, err := client.AuthSource().Header(t.Context())
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		assert.Equal(t, gitlab.AccessTokenHeaderName, key)
+		assert.Equal(t, "config-pat", value)
+	})
+}

+func TestNewClientFromConfig_WithoutAuthentication(t *testing.T) {
+	keyring.MockInit()
+	t.Cleanup(keyring.MockInit)
+
+	t.Setenv("GITLAB_TOKEN", "")
+	t.Setenv("GITLAB_ACCESS_TOKEN", "")
+	t.Setenv("OAUTH_TOKEN", "")
+	t.Setenv("GLAB_IS_OAUTH2", "")
+	t.Setenv("JOB_TOKEN", "")
+	t.Setenv("CI_JOB_TOKEN", "")
+	t.Setenv("GITLAB_CI", "")
+	t.Setenv("GLAB_USE_KEYRING", "")
+	t.Setenv("USE_KEYRING", "")
+
+	var gotHeader string
+	server := httptest.NewTLSServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		gotHeader = r.Header.Get("X-Test-Header")
+		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
+	}))
+	t.Cleanup(server.Close)
+
+	hostname := strings.TrimPrefix(server.URL, "https://")
+	cfg := config.NewFromString(fmt.Sprintf(`
+---
+hosts:
+  %s:
+    use_keyring: "true"
+    is_oauth2: "true"
+    skip_tls_verify: "true"
+    custom_headers:
+      - name: X-Test-Header
+        value: from-config
+`, hostname))
+
+	client, err := NewClientFromConfig(hostname, cfg, false, "test-agent", WithoutAuthentication())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	_, _, err = client.AuthSource().Header(t.Context())
+	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "unauthenticated")
+
+	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(t.Context(), http.MethodGet, server.URL, http.NoBody)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	resp, err := client.HTTPClient().Do(req)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.NoError(t, resp.Body.Close())
+	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, resp.StatusCode)
+	assert.Equal(t, "from-config", gotHeader)
+}

+//go:build !integration
+
+package docker
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/docker/docker-credential-helpers/credentials"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"github.com/zalando/go-keyring"
+
+	"gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/internal/api"
+	"gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/internal/config"
+	"gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/internal/glinstance"
+	"gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/internal/testing/cmdtest"
+)
+
+func TestCredentialHelper_DefaultHostMissingKeyringToken(t *testing.T) {
+	keyring.MockInit()
+	t.Cleanup(keyring.MockInit)
+
+	t.Setenv("GITLAB_TOKEN", "")
+	t.Setenv("GITLAB_ACCESS_TOKEN", "")
+	t.Setenv("OAUTH_TOKEN", "")
+	t.Setenv("GLAB_IS_OAUTH2", "")
+	t.Setenv("JOB_TOKEN", "")
+	t.Setenv("CI_JOB_TOKEN", "")
+	t.Setenv("GITLAB_CI", "")
+	t.Setenv("GLAB_ENABLE_CI_AUTOLOGIN", "")
+
+	cfg := config.NewFromString(`
+---
+hosts:
+  gitlab.com:
+    use_keyring: "true"
+    user: default-user
+    container_registry_domains: registry.gitlab.com
+    artifact_registry_domains: artifacts.gitlab.com
+  gitlab.example.com:
+    user: example-user
+    token: example-token
+    container_registry_domains: registry.gitlab.example.com
+`)
+
+	run := func(t *testing.T, registry string) (string, error) {
+		t.Helper()
+
+		exec := cmdtest.SetupCmdForTest(t, NewCmdCredentialHelper, false,
+			cmdtest.WithConfig(cfg),
+			cmdtest.WithStdin(registry),
+			// Same as the real factory, so the default host's missing token
+			// fails here if the helper builds its client through f.ApiClient.
+			cmdtest.WithApiClientFunc(func(repoHost string) (*api.Client, error) {
+				if repoHost == "" {
+					repoHost = glinstance.DefaultHostname
+				}
+				return api.NewClientFromConfig(repoHost, cfg, false, "test-agent")
+			}),
+		)
+
+		out, err := exec("get")
+		return out.String(), err
+	}
+
+	t.Run("a registry on another host still gets its credentials", func(t *testing.T) {
+		out, err := run(t, "registry.gitlab.example.com")
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+
+		var creds credentials.Credentials
+		require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(out), &creds))
+		assert.Equal(t, "example-user", creds.Username)
+		assert.Equal(t, "example-token", creds.Secret)
+	})
+
+	t.Run("the default host's container registry still fails", func(t *testing.T) {
+		_, err := run(t, "registry.gitlab.com")
+		require.ErrorContains(t, err, "glab token for this registryURL (hostname) is empty")
+	})
+
+	t.Run("the default host's artifact registry names the missing keyring token", func(t *testing.T) {
+		_, err := run(t, "artifacts.gitlab.com")
+		require.Error(t, err)
+		assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "operating system keyring")
+		assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "glab auth login --hostname gitlab.com")
+	})
+}

+	requests := make(chan string, 10)
+	server := httptest.NewTLSServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		requests <- r.URL.Path
+		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest)
+	}))
+	t.Cleanup(server.Close)
+	hostname := strings.TrimPrefix(server.URL, "https://")

+	d := t.TempDir()

+	require.NoError(t, cfg.Set(hostname, "client_id", "test-client-id"))
+	require.NoError(t, cfg.Set(hostname, "skip_tls_verify", "true"))
+
+	exec := cmdtest.SetupCmdForTest(t, NewCmdLogin, false,
+		cmdtest.WithConfig(cfg),
+		cmdtest.WithApiClientFunc(func(repoHost string) (*api.Client, error) {
+			return api.NewClientFromConfig(repoHost, cfg, false, "test-agent")
+		}),
+	)
+
+	_, err := exec("--hostname " + hostname + " --device")
+	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "failed to start device authorization")
+	require.Len(t, requests, 1)
+	assert.Equal(t, "/oauth/authorize_device", <-requests)
+
+	useKeyring, _ := cfg.Get(hostname, "use_keyring")
+	assert.Equal(t, "true", useKeyring)
+}

+//go:build !integration
+
+package config
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+)
+
+func TestHostUsesKeyring(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("GLAB_USE_KEYRING", "")
+	t.Setenv("USE_KEYRING", "")
+
+	t.Run("the host entry sets use_keyring", func(t *testing.T) {
+		cfg := NewFromString("---\nhosts:\n  gitlab.example.com:\n    use_keyring: \"true\"\n")
+
+		assert.True(t, HostUsesKeyring(cfg, "gitlab.example.com"))
+		assert.False(t, HostUsesKeyring(cfg, "other.example.com"))
+	})
+
+	t.Run("a top-level use_keyring does not count", func(t *testing.T) {
+		cfg := NewFromString("---\nuse_keyring: \"true\"\nhosts:\n  gitlab.example.com:\n    user: someone\n")
+
+		assert.False(t, HostUsesKeyring(cfg, "gitlab.example.com"))
+	})
+
+	t.Run("GLAB_USE_KEYRING does not count", func(t *testing.T) {
+		t.Setenv("GLAB_USE_KEYRING", "true")
+		cfg := NewFromString("---\nhosts:\n  gitlab.example.com:\n    user: someone\n")
+
+		assert.False(t, HostUsesKeyring(cfg, "gitlab.example.com"))
+	})
+}
